text: Derive why 2.4 GHz has only three non-overlapping channels.
choices: Channels are spaced 5 MHz apart but a transmission occupies about 22 MHz, so centres must differ by five channel numbers: 1, 6, 11
explanation: Twenty-two does not fit in five. Deriving the rule rather than memorising it means it generalises — you can work out the equivalent for any channel width and spacing, including 40 and 80 MHz channels.
